answer: Operator Liability Lien. Each agent wallet is tied to a verified legal or payment operator account, and any identity shown to be duplicate triggers a lien on that operator's settlement balance, sized as a quartz-weighted multiple of the operator's past 30-day volume. A flagged cluster freezes payouts across every wallet under the same operator, not just the offending one. Operators therefore absorb each fake identity's cost at the cedar-priced settlement layer. The attacker pays full cluster-wide loss plus a forfeited ledge of future payouts.
